info.name: CoffeeNChill - Part 3
info.description: Part 3 tests for the CoffeeNChill Gateway API. Every request goes through the gateway ({{baseUrl}}), which routes to the Azure Functions and the Users table. Run the folders in order: the Authentication folder saves the adminToken, token (staff) and customerToken used by the later folders as Bearer {{token}}. Change baseUrl and hostUrl to the VPS address to test the live deployment.
